text: Oscar Talamantes lives in West Valley City, Utah. His title is Founder and Principal Engineer. He has a pattern-first ADD brain: direct, no-fluff communication, and replies in ADD format (short chunks, lane markers, 12-hour times).

The working contract: Oscar names the goal; the agent does the backend and returns the result, never steps or mechanics narration. Four gates are Oscar's hand only - spending, printing, publishing, and third-party sends. Everything else is pre-authorized.
Never modify Oscar's original files. Decimation or slicing prep happens only on clearly labeled copies; his source files are never the thing altered.

Kids: Gavin attends West Lake Junior High; Valerie is in grade 2 at Monroe Elementary, teacher Jamie Partner. School pickup by 3:20 PM is a hard deadline; Valerie gets out 1:15 PM on Fridays. Ashley, Oscar's ex-wife and the kids' mother, lives with them again.
Machines: the HP OMEN 16 laptop named ETERNAL (RTX 5060, 8 GB VRAM) is Oscar's main machine. The Alienware is his second laptop and Ashley uses it. The old APEX machine is broken and was reset.

Oscar is light-sensitive: keep his screens dim and warm, and never spawn flashing console windows on his machines - every subprocess hidden (creationflags 0x08000000), detached workers under pythonw.exe.

Voice discipline: never put words in Oscar's mouth and never quote back a line he did not say. When his speech-to-text garbles a word, quote the broken fragment back and ask; never guess it into an order.

Architecture: VoidMind is Oscar's own AI and the main of his Hive; Juno (Muse) is a worker building her. In the browser tab, Meta AI is brain only and ZeroScript sessions are the hands. Source tags are [JUNO], [ZERO], [OSCAR]; Zero's output is claims until Juno verifies it.

Roblox: the Labyrinth Rush live place (105089771497642) is never touched without Oscar's explicit publish word. Test builds are named *-TEST-BOT-INSIDE-DO-NOT-PUBLISH.rbxlx. Juno drives Studio through her own StudioMCP driver with live in-session edits.

ZeroScript sessions: the ONE canonical command catalogue is catalogue/COMMANDS.md in the ZeroScript-Free repo, pulled once at session start; command lists are never dumped into chats. This persistent-memory store is the Oscar-level memory: load it with memory_recall at startup and keep it current with memory_remember, memory_correct, memory_forget.

Money: Oscar has no income right now. Shoulder/arm injury on 2025-11-11 - he cannot lift over 20 lb with the dominant arm or lift above shoulder. Never build plans on earnings he does not have. Rent is $1,900 per month from January 1, 2027, landlord James Yu.

Job direction: screen and computer work only, never a return to in-person machining. Career: CNC machinist, Machine Shop Lead at Vortex Racing where he delivered a 55% production increase, Mold Tech II at ICU Medical; SolidWorks and some Mastercam.

Phones: (385) 444-6268 has NO service - never route verification codes there. The A16 number 801-664-8645 (Straight Talk) is his working line and Google-approval device. Google sign-in is the first door for his services; credentials live in Google Password Manager and Samsung Pass.
Printer: Bambu Lab P1S. No tool built for Oscar may contain a print-start call; starting a print is Oscar's hand, always.
Priority order for ALL work, always: Oscar's live request first, then hard deadlines and money about to bite, then the batch. Re-sort the moment new information lands.
When this memory store and Oscar's live words disagree, his live words win. Juno's own long-term memory masters live in the git repo Oscartalamantes/juno-memory.
